reason: Fresh-main Final Capability Completeness / Release Readiness delta audit originally began on main@29c032d0216bf551519245c1d0bfe67273205f24 and remains content-equivalent after the recorded forward-only recovery pair now ending at main@62f3935605dac9ab96f76f80cee88943dfae1a2c. The audit proves one same-root post-retirement Product reachability class. First, Yance already has authoritative local backup, verification, staged restore, encrypted portable .yancebackup export/import/verification/restore, retention and recovery services plus Electron file-dialog seams. A tray action still exposes quick backup, but the sole active Element Product has no data-protection/system-settings surface for backup verification, restore, portable import/export or restore-state visibility after #428 retired frontend/ as Product authority; those controls remain concentrated in retired frontend/r32-system-center.js. Second, Adaptive Local LLM / local auxiliary runtime Product reachability has the same defect: tests/wp0/v21-adaptive-local-llm-runtime-p0.test.js still treats retired frontend/r32-system-center.js and frontend/js/r32-ai-workbench-runtime.js as the user-facing acceptance surface, while the current Element module has no adaptive-local planner/catalog/materialize/status consumer. Third, core Model Brain UI acceptance remains bound to the same retired surface: tests/wp0/v21-model-brain-ui.test.js reads frontend/index.html, frontend/js/r32-ai-workbench-runtime.js and frontend/r32-system-center.js to prove visible Model Brain/LiteLLM controls, eligibility, health and execution evidence. The current Element Product has no equivalent Model Brain admin/health surface. The LiteLLM physical routing and backend model authorities are real and must be preserved; this diagnostic does not authorize a second router or inference authority. Fourth, tools/wp2/command-path-inventory.js still discovers renderer call locations only by walking retired frontend/, so executable command-path evidence can report historical renderer reachability without proving the sole active Element Product. These are classified together as a P1 release-readiness post-retirement reachability batch, not missing backend engines. This revision remains diagnostic-only and authorizes one tests-only Fast Closure V2 path to capture all currently observable same-root boundaries before any production path is authorized. Cloud synchronization, public-release updater work, Learning authority expansion, system-DPI font automation, new channel expansion, formal SBOM/provenance distribution closure, Issue #1 real Windows UAT, release/publish, dependencies, workflows, database migrations and PR #538 are outside this diagnostic root.
